scope: Generic local Modifier instance lookup/add/refresh/activation/destroy/dirty-removal boundaries and their integration point with KERNEL-EVENT-001. It does not claim generic callback bodies, source formulas, global lookup or every stacking flag.

local_evidence.support: AddModifier task evaluates ordered targets, calls TryAddModifierInstance, then completes its task boundary.
ordered local lookup, Multiple/refresh branch families, OnAdded/OnActivate alive transition, destroy ToBeRemoved transition and backwards dirty removal preserving survivor order.
stable property-contribution source slots across add/refresh/remove.

external_evidence.support: current recursive external slice contains 203 AddModifier, 18 RemoveModifier, 29 StackProperty and 148 Modifier callback entrypoints; all are retained as non-compiled behavior.

state_model.instance_identity: instance_id plus name, stacking flag, optional caster runtime ID and optional source-provider identity; lookup is ordered front-to-back and returns its first match.

selected_transitions.add_new: target selection is a dependency; append identity-preserved instance in TO_BE_ADDED (reference action APPEND_NEW_PENDING / APPEND_MULTIPLE_PENDING), invoke the OnAdded boundary, then OnActivate sets ALIVE (reference action ACTIVATE_ALIVE) before its callbacks are dispatchable.
selected_transitions.duplicate_lookup: search local ModifierList front-to-back using name, stacking, optional active-state, optional caster runtime ID and source-provider identity; do not use general object equality.
selected_transitions.multiple_4: append a duplicate pending instance and activate it at the same OnAdded->OnActivate boundary.
selected_transitions.refresh_replace_2_5_7_8_12: retain existing identity and set CurrentLife plus Count from incoming config/runtime data.
selected_transitions.refresh_prolong_3: retain existing identity and add current life; exact count/UI callback behavior is outside this packet.
selected_transitions.refresh_merge_6: retain existing identity and use max current life; exact count/UI callback behavior is outside this packet.
selected_transitions.refresh_keep_lifetime_10: retain existing current life and set Count.
selected_transitions.destroy: if state is ALIVE or TO_BE_ADDED, set TO_BE_REMOVED and record reason; cleanup callbacks are KERNEL-EVENT work, not implicit deletion.
selected_transitions.dirty_removal: at explicit cleanup, remove non-ALIVE items with no destroy guard; preserve relative order of all survivors. The reference transition returns deregistered callback registration keys and removed property-contribution keys so the same lifecycle boundary performs deregistration and property cleanup atomically.
selected_transitions.lifetime_tick: each ALIVE instance with an explicit current_life decrements by one per tick; reaching zero marks it TO_BE_REMOVED with destroy_reason 1. Instances without current_life are permanent within this packet. Actual removal still waits for dirty_removal.
selected_transitions.property_contribution: keep a modifier-owned stable source index/key across refresh; do not shift neighbouring sources on removal. Materialization itself delegates to the existing property packets.

event_contract.registration: only ALIVE modifiers contribute callbacks; callback identity is supplied to KERNEL-EVENT-001.
event_contract.ordering: callback priority and source task order delegate to KERNEL-EVENT-001; lifecycle transitions commit before the next compiled sibling observes modifier state.
event_contract.unsupported: OnAdded/OnActivate/OnReplace callback bodies, delayed-add queue trigger timing and global manager ordering are not silently modeled.

unsupported_cases: stacking flags 0,1,9 and any unlisted flag
tick scheduling owner and tick phase boundary
dispel policy beyond a separately compiled DispelStatus operation
acceptance_fixture: tests/game_data/test_modifier_lifecycle_reference.py proves pending append -> ACTIVATE_ALIVE, Multiple append, Replace, Prolong, Merge, Keep-Lifetime, mark-destroy, ordered dirty removal, callback/property-key cleanup, and lifetime tick expiry transitions. external operation risk triage retains source Add/Remove/Stack nodes as compiler blockers until compiled.
dsh_implementation_contract: Implement immutable ModifierState/ModifierInstance records with the stated ordered lookup and explicit transitions. Do not delete on Destroy immediately, do not reorder survivors, do not represent property contribution as final-value +/- arithmetic, and reject unsupported stacking/global policies until their packets are provided.
